messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing Q&A — two items I wasn't able to confirm in the live thread: dev sandbox credit reset timing, and rate-limit/exemption flow for infra/test runs. @Leah can you confirm?

Leah (CEO): Thanks for flagging, Alex. Short answers: dev sandbox credits reset monthly (UTC-first-of-month) and rate-limit exemptions are currently manual approvals but we're working on self-serve. More below.

Riley: To add some nuance — Dedicated customers have reserved throughput + a burst pool. If you exceed reserved throughput we try to serve from the burst pool, otherwise you get rate-limited.

Jamal (SRE): Quick clarifying Q — is the burst pool per-customer or shared across customers? And how do we surface when someone is using burst vs reserved?

Sana (Finance): For standard self-serve dev accounts: monthly sandbox credits are a small fixed pool and they do not roll over today. Enterprise contracts can negotiate rollover or buffer credits as part of the T&Cs.

Riley: Answering Jamal — burst pool is global per-cluster but enforced with per-customer soft caps so one customer can't starve others. We emit metrics and exposure via the Console per-route ("burst_used", "reserved_used"). Example config snippet from runtime: 

```
burst_policy:
  type: global_pool
  soft_cap_per_customer: 2x_reserved
  cooldown_sec: 300
```

Jamal (SRE): Nice, thanks. Is there an established programmatic way to request temporary test exemptions (e.g., header or flag) for CI runs? That would help infra teams run larger scale load tests without manual approvals.

OpsBot: Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/pricing/test-exemptions — form + approver list is linked there. (bot message)

Sana (Finance): Today the process is a request form + finance/security approval for anything > 1M tokens in a billing period. For small CI bursts we can manually grant short-lived exemptions but we want to productize this.

Leah (CEO): Roadmap note: H2 we plan a self-serve exemption toggle for org owners, plus admin UI for short-lived test allowances and audit logs. We're also exploring a pilot for dev credit rollovers with a limited group.

Alex: Great — action items: I'll open a GH issue to track the self-serve exemption work and add a follow-up item to next all-hands. @Riley @Sana please comment if we missed anything. :thumbsup:

Riley: Ack.

Jamal (SRE): Thanks everyone, that helps.
